entries.title: Hebrews 13:2
segments:
Strangers. There was then no feeling of international brotherhood  such as has since been manifested; but there was a solid preparation for it in Roman citizenship, which created a community of interest throughout that vast empire.
 

 
 Angels unawares. See

entries.title: Hebrews 13:3
segments: Bonds. Already the Christians were suffering persecution.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:4
segments: God will judge. Alluding to the impossibility of escaping punishment for a sin which human judgment and penalty so often fail to overtake because of its secrecy.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:5
segments: Content. This is no condoning of indolence or lack of rightful ambition.  But even trifling discontent may blind one to God's blessings, and rob one of all enjoyment.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:7
segments: Issue of their life. The way they kept their faith and holy living even until death.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:9
segments: Strange teachings. The doctrines of those who were trying to establish in the early church certain ceremonial practices of the Mosaic law.  They were probably connected with the sacrificial meals (

entries.title: Hebrews 13:10
segments: No right to eat. Referring to those who sought spiritual strength by sacrificial offerings or ceremonial purity, according to the old and superseded service of the tabernacle.  These had no right to eat at the Christian altar; that is, they had not accepted the salvation by faith which came to them by the voluntary sacrifice of Christ.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:16
segments: Communicate. Contribute, be generous in ministering to the necessities of the saints (

entries.title: Hebrews 13:19
segments: Be restored. That the present exile of the writer of the epistle from his readers may soon end.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:20
segments:
God of peace. The God Who alone can give spiritual peace.
 

 
 Brought again from the dead. The resurrection of Jesus Christ.
 

 
 With the blood of an eternal covenant. See

entries.title: Hebrews 13:22
segments: Bear with the word of exhortation. Read and ponder patiently and prayerfully the words of this epistle.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:23
segments: Timothy. This is the only reference which proves that Timothy was ever imprisoned.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:24
segments:
All them. The epistle was addressed to certain Christian communities as a whole, not to their rulers.
 

 
 They of Italy. Italian residents in the place where the writer of the epistle lived.
